description: Source code for the Starboard Android Cobalt shared configuration, defining a class that customizes test filters, environment variables, and handles specific test exclusions for the Android platform.

classes.name: CobaltAndroidConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for Cobalt on Android, extending the base CobaltConfiguration to include Android-specific test filtering and environment setup.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Extends the base method to add Android-specific test filters based on a filtered tests map.

methods.name: GetTestEnvVariables
methods.description: Returns environment variables for different test suites, disabling leak detection.

methods.name: GetWebPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Extends the base method to add specific web platform test filters, including security policy and websocket tests.
